args.task_description: 实现 issue-59-windows 功能：Issue 59 Windows ConPTY and Ubuntu PTY. Add the first bounded native pseudo-terminal execution layer on top of verified exec-unification without widening local execution authority. Preserve existing admission, capability, exec-policy, process-tree, cancel and no-replay semantics. Use Windows ConPTY on Windows and a real PTY primitive on Ubuntu/Linux. Keep bounded terminal IO, resize, close, cancel and process-tree cleanup explicit. Do not implement sandboxing, Hooks, snapshots, cloud authority, UI or packaging in this issue. Reuse existing process manager/session abstractions where possible instead of duplicating execution ownership. Require pre-edit GitNexus context/impact, HIGH or CRITICAL review before edits, staged detect non-false-clean, Windows 2025 and Ubuntu 24.04 real PTY lifecycle, Unicode, resize, cancel and process-tree tests, exact source hashes, fast-forward/no-force-push publication and rollback evidence.
